title: Warranty coverage and ownership concerns
summary: This topic centers on warranty coverage questions, a few reported warranty-related problems, and several fragments whose meaning or sentiment is unclear or mixed across unrelated subjects.

negative.summary: Negative reviews mention warranty problems and a defect case where warranty coverage was needed for the glass.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention warranty expiration concerns, uncovered stress or expenses, administrative warranty notices, and unrelated running or battery remarks without clear evaluative sentiment.

limitations: The sample is dominated by undetermined fragments, so clear sentiment evidence is limited.
The cluster mixes warranty coverage, ownership intent, service communication, remote running behavior, and battery remarks rather than one fully coherent issue.
Some undetermined fragments contain ambiguous wording or references that do not clearly describe a customer evaluation of the vehicle or warranty experience.
